Explanation:  
The question asks for the age of Egon Sendler's book at the time of the New Hampshire Democratic state election results (53.9% and 125,822 votes), assuming the book was written in the same year as the birth of Nemanja Markovic. The Ground Truth Answer is "51 years." The Predicted Answer calculated the age to be "11 years," based on the actual publication year of the book (2001) and the year of the election results (2012): 2012 - 2001 = 11 years.

However, the Ground Truth Answer (51 years) suggests that Nemanja Markovic was born in 1961 (2012 - 51 = 1961), and the book, under the hypothetical condition, should have been considered as written in 1961. The LLM response did not acknowledge the hypothetical scenario and instead used the actual publication year of the book, not Markovic's birth year. Therefore, the Predicted Answer does not contain the substance or vital fact present in the Ground Truth Answer.

Decision: FALSE
